visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a high-angle view of a backyard area featuring a light-colored tiled patio transitioning into a green grassy lawn. In the background, against a textured brown fence, a cluster of approximately five small cats is visible, some standing and some lying down in the shade. The setting is bathed in bright, direct natural daylight. (2) The camera zooms in closer to the feline group huddled near the base of the brown wall. One tabby kitten lies curled on the grass while three others stand protectively around it, their ears perked and eyes fixed on the camera. Potted plants, including orchids and ferns, hang from the wall above them, adding texture to the background. (3) A kitten with white fur on its chest and face and grey patches on its back begins to walk cautiously away from the group towards the left side of the frame. The remaining tabby kittens stay stationary near the wall, maintaining their curious gaze toward the observer as the camera holds its position during the movement.
